description: Lead the end-to-end development of Gaia, a high-performance data platform for geospatial analytics and real-time robot operations at scale. Built the core engine behind its visual app builder, which lets users create data-driven workflows, dashboards, and custom apps with minimal code.
Designed and implemented third-party integrations for custodial crypto wallets on Cybrid's crypto-as-a-service platform for banks.

Built and maintained the payments backend for Ario's lending platform — integrating EFT and ACH workflows with Canadian banks, automating payment scheduling, retries, and settlement tracking, and adding Equifax-based KYC verification for regulatory compliance.
Maintained and extended Makerepo.com, the Makerspace's project-sharing website, and built MakerRoom, a room-booking site for its spaces.
Automated merchant onboarding, led the API integration for digital signatures, and built the front end of an analytics app for merchants to track sales and earnings.
